## Goal
- Complete the two PARTIAL IVX IA chat capabilities (new apps from scratch + stress test) end-to-end with live proof, then build and deploy a new APK v1.4.10(42).

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Every engineering request must create a real persistent job (not narrative-only)
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files MUST use `gzipSync` (NOT `deflateSync`); omit `contentEncoding` for small files <~30KB
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login; length ~1620; expires frequently — re-mint as needed)
- `/tmp/` files get wiped by sandbox resets — recreate via heredoc each time
- Chat bounded poll: 55s timeout, 1.5s interval — if job still running, chat returns progress block; worker continues in background
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox (nice_value=19) — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir with shim script that exits 1
- Generated TypeScript code embedded inside outer template literals is DANGEROUS — `${...}` in generated code is eagerly evaluated by outer template → ReferenceError → worker crash → job orphaned at RUNNING 10% forever. MUST use array-join with string concatenation instead.
- `pkill` commands cause shell exit code 128 in this sandbox — use `kill -9 <pid>` or `ps -ef | grep` + manual kill instead

## Progress
### Done
- **EXECUTIVE LAYER FORENSIC AUDIT — ALL 15 PHASES COMPLETE + ALL 3 FINDINGS FIXED + LIVE-VERIFIED** (deploy `745af05f`, 25/25 metrics PASS)

- **CHAT ↔ WORKER SYNC — ROUTING DEFECT FIXED (7 commits, all LIVE)**:
  - Commits `b76cd6a9` → `9c50cf58`: 6 commits guarding all 4 short-circuit layers + goal-driven patch brain + approval-text fix
  - Commit `80adc7c2` — creative sample-file creation path

- **CREATIVE SAMPLE FIX VERIFIED LIVE**: Chat prompt → worker job completed, real file `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-samples/sample-11a97fdf.ts` created, committed as `5216e00aee1c`, verified on GitHub.

- **APK v1.4.9(41) BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE**: 84.5 MB at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.9.apk (hash-verified 3-way)

- **STRESS-TEST HARNESS — COMPLETE WITH LIVE PROOF**:
  - Commit `5d15be4c` (array-join fix) deployed LIVE, verified at `/health`
  - Fresh job `ivx-worker-867895ab` → COMPLETED 100%, `ok: True`
  - Real harness file `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-samples/stress-tests/stress-ec0298f1.ts` (4450 bytes, sha `ce9e5f97bbe8`) verified on GitHub
  - Real bounded harness: 100 requests, 20 concurrency, 5s timeout, p50/p90/p99 latency percentiles, read-only GET /health, writes JSON results
  - Auto-committed by worker in `d8201cb26eab`

- **NEW-APP SCAFFOLDER — COMPLETE WITH LIVE PROOF**:
  - Two bugs found in first test run (job `a68959b2` FAILED at validation gate):
    - Bug 1: `extractAppName` grabbed "from-scratch-called-investor-tracker" instead of "investor-tracker"

  - Both fixed in commit `9d70814f` (LIVE, verified at `/health`):
    - `extractAppName` now matches `called X` / `named X` pattern FIRST, then falls back to `app X` pattern
    - Test file uses `node:test` + `node:assert/strict` (passes import-smoke gate, runs under both `bun test` and `node --test`)
  - Fresh job `ivx-worker-adf96907` → COMPLETED 100%, `ok: True`, correct slug `investor-tracker`
  - 4 real files verified on GitHub under `apps/investor-tracker/`:
    - `package.json` (467 bytes, sha `7be9efeb1c42`)
    - `index.ts` (914 bytes, sha `d6f3dfa23dc6`)
    - `README.md` (622 bytes, sha `c667019ed15c`)
    - `index.test.ts` (1175 bytes, sha `47ceb78429ac`)
  - Test executed against GitHub-committed files: 3 pass, 0 fail (real bun test proof)
  - Auto-committed by worker in `52e6757d891f`

- **INTENT ROUTER GUARD EXTENDED** (commit `d4e9942d`, LIVE): `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` includes `hasAppScaffoldSignal` + `hasStressTestSignal`

- **TEMPLATE-LITERAL INTERPOLATION BUGS FIXED** (commits `a082008e`, `8f31cf36`, `5d15be4c`): All `${...}` in generated code eliminated via array-join pattern

- **APK v1.4.10(42) VERSION BUMPED**: build.gradle (versionCode 42, versionName "1.4.10") + app.config.ts (version '1.4.10', buildMarker 'IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_19_BUILD_42_SENIOR_DEV_APP_SCAFFOLD_STRESS_TEST', versionCode 42)

### In Progress
- **APK v1.4.10(42) BUILD RUNNING**: Gradle `assembleRelease` in background (PID 11698), Metro bundler completed (4162 modules, 25983ms), now packaging APK. Build log at `/tmp/apk_build_v1410.log`. Watchman shim at `/tmp/nowatch/watchman` (exits 1). Old stale APK from v1.4.9 still at `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk` (Jul 19 11:41, 84536896 bytes). Need to poll for `BUILD_EXIT=0` + new APK timestamp, then upload to ivxholding.com.

### Blocked
- 17 pre-existing TypeScript errors in files NOT touched by fixes — full `bunx tsc --noEmit` fails; workaround: `focused` validation mode + import smoke
- Factory agents FA-01..50 and senior devs SD-0002..0012 require owner approvals (factory isolation infrastructure, Apple/Google credentials, pilot selection, FA build approval, deploy-hook regeneration)

## Key Decisions
- Four-layer router guard: `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` must guard ALL four short-circuit paths — any one unguarded hijacks the prompt
- Production-execution signal detector: 2+ of {commit+github, deploy+render, verify+/health, bump+version/marker} → true; PLUS `hasAppScaffoldSignal` OR `hasStressTestSignal` → true (single-signal)
- **Array-join pattern for generated code**: NEVER embed generated TypeScript (which uses its own `${...}`) inside an outer template literal. Always use `lines.join('\n')` with string concatenation.
- `IVXCodePatchOperation.kind` expanded: `'replace_exact' | 'create_file'`
- `applyPatchProposal` handles `create_file` by mkdir + writeFile (refuses overwrite if file exists)
- Validation for `create_file`: `focused` mode (bun test) + `runNodeImportSmoke` — NOT `typecheck` mode
- App scaffold creates 4 files: package.json (real module manifest), index.ts (exported app object + runApp function), README.md (documentation), index.test.ts (node:test + node:assert/strict unit tests — NOT bun:test, fails import-smoke gate)
- Stress test harness: bounded (100 requests, 20 concurrency, 5s timeout), targets /health (read-only), writes JSON results file
- `gzipSync` (not `deflateSync`) for gzip-base64 commits
- Watchman fix: shim script at `/tmp/nowatch/watchman` that echoes "unavailable" and exits 1 — gradle/expo falls back to node crawler
- `extractAppName` regex: match `called X` / `named X` FIRST (before `app X`), with clause boundary at end (`\b|$|[.,;!?]`)

## Next Steps
1. Poll `/tmp/apk_build_v1410.log` for `BUILD_EXIT=0` — confirms APK v1.4.10(42) build completed
2. Verify new APK timestamp/size differs from stale v1.4.9 (Jul 19 11:41, 84536896 bytes)
3. Upload APK to ivxholding.com via owner-gated action (CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD)
4. Verify APK live at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.10.apk
5. Report to owner: both PARTIAL items complete + new APK deployed

## Critical Context
- **Current live runtime SHA**: `9d70814f6df8` (extractAppName slug fix + node:test fix) — both PARTIAL items verified working on this runtime
- **Full commit chain this session** (10 commits): `30e1afd` (both builders) → `d4e9942d` (router guard) → `a082008e` (${input} fix) → `8f31cf36` (${res.status} fix) → `5d15be4c` (final array-join rewrite) → `d8201cb2` (stress-test auto-commit) → `9d70814f` (slug + node:test fix) → `52e6757d` (new-app auto-commit)
- **Both PARTIAL items PROVEN end-to-end**: stress-test job COMPLETED 100% + harness on GitHub; new-app job COMPLETED 100% + 4 files on GitHub + test 3 pass 0 fail
- **Root cause of orphaned jobs (now fixed)**: Generated TS code with `${input}`, `${res.status}` inside outer template literals → ReferenceError at runtime → worker crash → job stuck at RUNNING 10% forever
- **Root cause of new-app validation gate failure (now fixed)**: `bun:test` import fails Node import-smoke on production → switched to `node:test` + `node:assert/strict`
- **Root cause of bad slug (now fixed)**: `extractAppName` matched `app\s+X` pattern which grabbed "from-scratch-called-investor-tracker" → now matches `called\s+X` first
- `IVX_SAFE_PATCH_CONFIRM_TEXT = 'CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH'`, `IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_CONFIRM_TEXT = 'CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR'`
- Owner needs 6 items for FINAL MANDATE Phases 3-7: (1) factory isolation infra, (2) SD-0002..0012 activation approvals, (3) FA-01..50 build approval, (4) pilot app selection, (5) Apple/Google credentials, (6) deploy-hook regeneration
- Render status `ok: false` is a cosmetic false-negative from missing optional env vars — actual deploys work fine
- APK build requires watchman shim in PATH first (`/tmp/nowatch/watchman` exits 1) — gradle hangs indefinitely on watchman otherwise
